name: Blacklash's Bindings
summary: Blacklash's Bindings are proof that the black drake Blacklash has been slain. They are sought by those trying to end the threat posed by the drakes of Lethlor Ravine.

sections.title: A Drakeslayer's Proof
sections.body: In Lethlor Ravine, Blacklash's Bindings mark the end of a black drake's imprisonment and the danger that followed. The seal holding Blacklash and Hematus depends on three runestones taken from nearby pillars with the Sign of the Earth. Once the seal is broken, both drakes are freed. Their bindings are then brought back as proof of Blacklash's death.

faq.answer: Blacklash's Bindings are a keepsake taken from the black drake after his death in Lethlor Ravine.
Blacklash is a black drake imprisoned with Hematus beneath the Seal of the Earth in Lethlor Ravine.

faq.q: Where do the bindings come from?
faq.answer: The bindings come from Blacklash in the Badlands.
Those seeking to end the danger from Blacklash and Hematus ask for the bindings as proof that Blacklash is dead.

faq.q: How were Blacklash and Hematus freed?
faq.answer: The Sign of the Earth lets its bearer take three runestones from the pillars in Lethlor Ravine. Placing them in the Seal of the Earth frees both drakes.
